figure_contract.direct_comparisons: Common bin edges and common scales are used.
figure_contract.physical_networks: 69 physical edges per environment; reciprocal OSMnx arcs are not plotted.

interpretation_constraints: No environment is objectively better or worse.
Orientation entropy or phi is not universally good or bad.
Behavioral and navigation conclusions require independent wayfinding evidence.

line_geometry_definitions.edge_circuity: LineString length divided by endpoint chord for an eligible edge.
line_geometry_definitions.endpoint_chord: Euclidean local-coordinate distance between physical-edge endpoints.
line_geometry_definitions.network_circuity: Sum of eligible LineString lengths divided by sum of corresponding chords.

local_coordinate_limitation: GeoGami Local Cartesian coordinates are not longitude/latitude. Lengths remain local units, not metres. No WGS84 reprojection, geographic bearing, great-circle distance, or geographic nearest-node operation is used.
relative_difference_percent: 100 * (Env38 - Env39) / abs(Env39), only for nonzero scientifically appropriate geometry- or orientation-sensitive metrics; otherwise null
